[[Ewok Spear]] For a bit of wood and stone, this pesky little weapon can really hurt. I have seen [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] power = 0 with this one - now thats what I call a distraction! Just remember that your Ewoks will scream TARGET if you catch your opponent with this one more thanonce or twice - so keep a [[Crash Site Memorial]] or [[Baragwin]] on hand.

Combo: = one character excluded, one power zero, one forfeit zero, one moved away and one hit. Thats 5 characters pretty much decimated! And we haven't added power or battel damage yet!

= why risk a bad draw?
